summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing daily buyback disclosures under its $1 billion stock repurchase program, provided to the Australian Securities Exchange. The program authorizes repurchases of Class A and Class B common stock on an ongoing basis. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the disclosure is a routine ASX compliance requirement. The mechanics involve open-market purchases subject to market conditions and regulatory constraints. As a capital return event, the key watchpoint is the pace of repurchase execution, which signals management's valuation view and capital allocation priorities.
